purpose: Matched external test of whether older ecological history has different predictive value for coarse presence and quantitative percent cover under one SeagrassNet sampling design.

pre_response_schema_gate.requirement: README/schema must state or imply an identifier that is reused for the same quadrat across years within site. If quadrat labels are survey-specific or cannot be linked longitudinally without response values, terminate before opening biological CSV.
required_fields: Zostera marina percent cover on a 0-100 scale
pre_response_schema_gate.zero_semantics: 0 percent cover must be a valid observed value and must represent recorded absence of Zostera in a sampled quadrat; missing/NA must remain distinct from zero.
pre_response_schema_gate.forbidden_fallback: Do not switch to site-year, transect-year, or another coarser unit after response opening if stable quadrat identity fails.

panel_construction.coarse_state: 1 if observed Zostera percent cover > 0 in the stable quadrat-year; 0 if observed percent cover == 0
panel_construction.missing: exclude only truly unavailable quadrat-years; never convert missing to zero
panel_construction.transition_requirement: target year must equal source year + 1 for the same stable unit
panel_construction.history_requirement: primary older-history comparison requires at least two observed states strictly older than the source year
panel_construction.matched_rows: coarse and quantitative analyses use the same eligible stable-unit x target-year rows wherever both responses are defined

prediction_design.split: strict walk-forward by target calendar year; target year y trains only on eligible rows with target year < y
baseline: stable quadrat identity nested within site

older_history_operator.type: exponentially weighted mean of all observed states strictly before the source year

prediction_design.common_loss: mean squared error on [0,1] for both coarse and quantitative states
prediction_design.reason_for_common_learner_and_loss: remove learner-family and incompatible-loss alternatives from the state-dimension contrast

support_rules.lag1: supported separately for a state dimension only if lag1 beats baseline in >=60% of scored target years, median paired MSE delta (lag1-baseline) < 0, and one-sided paired target-year sign-flip p < 0.05
support_rules.older_history: supported separately for a state dimension only if older-history arm beats lag1 in >=60% of scored target years, median paired MSE delta (older-lag1) < 0, and one-sided paired target-year sign-flip p < 0.05
support_rules.primary_state_dimension_prediction: lag1 support for both dimensions; older-history support for coarse presence but not quantitative cover

independence_and_claim_boundary: This panel is external and published before the Tampa hypothesis, but some sites overlap NPS/SeagrassNet monitoring already represented elsewhere; do not call it a fully independent biological replication.
The analysis tests predictive memory structure, not causal ecological memory mechanism.
Do not infer that a longer predictive history in binary state is demographic persistence.
Do not exclude sites, years, or adverse results after response access.
Do not change stable unit, threshold, tau, learner, or loss after response access.
